Li2O(l).premise: JANAF provides paired crystal and liquid branches with a marked transition at 1843 K. The liquid standard must match Li-015, already used by the gas table.
Li2O(l).algebra: At 1843 K: ΔHfus = [(-553.247 + 144.742) - (-598.730 + 131.649)] kJ/mol = 58.576 kJ/mol. ΔSfus = 213.153 - 181.370 = 31.783 J/(mol K); Tm ΔSfus = 58.576069 kJ/mol; Cp_liquid=100.416 J/(mol K). The retained Li-015 branch follows G_l(T)=G_cr(Tm)-S_cr(Tm)(T-Tm)+ΔHfus(1-T/Tm)+Cp_l[(T-Tm)-T ln(T/Tm)]; the existing fitted coefficients are copied unchanged from the gas condensate rows.
Li2O(l).units_check: The fusion enthalpy difference is kJ/mol; J/(mol K) × K / 1000 = kJ/mol. Every term in the closed Gibbs expression is J/mol before conversion to the table units.
Li2O(l).sanity_value: ΔHfus and TmΔSfus agree to 0.000069 kJ/mol at printed precision; ΔGfus(Tm)=0.
flags: Source-derived; liquid branch is supercooled below 1843 K.

Li2SiO3(l).premise: Use primary Table 5 crystal Hf/S anchors, the JANAF Li-020 crystal thermal function, direct Téqui fusion calorimetry, and the published Li-021 liquid Cp.
Li2SiO3(l).algebra: At 1474 K, Hcr = -1646.1 + 169.896 kJ/mol. The selected crystal entropy is 79.8 + (298.915 - 80.295) = 298.420 J/(mol K), combining the Table 5 AC value with the Li-020 entropy increment. ΔSfus=71.3 kJ/mol / 1474 K=48.371778 J/(mol K), so G_liquid(Tm)=G_crystal(Tm)=-1916.075 kJ/mol.
Li2SiO3(l).units_check: T×S converts J/mol to J/mol; enthalpy inputs are kJ/mol.
Li2SiO3(l).sanity_value: G_liquid(1474 K)=-1916.075 kJ/mol; JANAF Li-021 implies ΔHfus≈28.033 kJ/mol, versus direct Téqui calorimetry 71.3±0.6 kJ/mol, so the mixed-source liquid branch is provisional.
flags: JANAF Li-021 implies ΔHfus≈28.033 kJ/mol; direct Téqui value is 71.3±0.6 kJ/mol.

Li4SiO4(l).premise: Use Ihle KEM crystal ΔHf, Kleykamp crystal enthalpy/fusion calorimetry, the provisional 2024 assessed S298, and a liquid Cp inferred by Hess closure to the liquid KEMS reaction.
Li4SiO4(l).algebra: Kleykamp reports H(T)-H(298.15)=-17156+73.694T+0.103210T²-4163115/T J/mol through 1300 K; differentiate for Cp and extrapolate 231 K to 1531 K, giving Hinc=334.843116 kJ/mol. Integrating Cp/T from 298.15 K with the provisional Table 5 S298=126 J/(mol K) gives Scr(1531)=523.582429 J/(mol K). ΔHfus=53 kJ/mol, ΔSfus=53000/1531=34.617897 J/(mol K). The liquid Cp is solved so ΔH298[Li4SiO4(l)→2Li(g)+1/2O2(g)+Li2SiO3(l)]=946.34 kJ/mol, giving 233.910854 J/(mol K).
Li4SiO4(l).units_check: Kleykamp H is J/mol and is divided by 1000 for kJ/mol. Cp/T integrates to J/(mol K); the KEMS Hess target is kJ/mol, with Cp·ΔT divided by 1000.
Li4SiO4(l).sanity_value: H_liquid(298.15 K)=-2229.433880 kJ/mol and the source KEMS reaction closes at 946.340 kJ/mol.
flags: Provisional S298=126 J/(mol K) is assessed, not measured.
Liquid Cp is inferred from the KEMS reaction and is not an independent holdout.
Selected Li2SiO3 solution-calorimetry Hf predicts the Ihle solid KEMS reaction at 1001.4 kJ/mol versus 960.70±2.38 kJ/mol; unresolved source conflict.
Li4SiO4 melting is described differently across phase-equilibrium sources; the 1531 K pure-liquid standard is an association construction and does not assert congruent melting.
